subject: Dedicated capacity demo request — throughput & latency requirements (StratusData)
messages:
From: Anna Patel <anna@stratusdata.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Demo request: Dedicated capacity for StratusData

Hi Kimberly,

I signed up through the self-serve form and wanted to follow up here. We are evaluating Redwood Dedicated for a production inference path and need to validate performance for our transformer-based retrieval pipeline. High-level requirements: ~200 QPS steady, spikes to 450 QPS for 5m windows, P95 token latency goal <= 200ms (95th percentile for 8k context).

We also need to confirm network egress policies (VPC peering) and whether we can run a short load test during the demo. Attaching a brief doc with current traffic patterns.

Can we book a focused technical demo this week? Prefer mornings (PST) or early afternoons (EST).

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Patel
Platform Lead, StratusData
anna@stratusdata.com

Attachment: capacity_requirements.docx (summary sheet)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Anna Patel <anna@stratusdata.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:35:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo request: Dedicated capacity for StratusData

Hi Anna — thanks for the details and for uploading the traffic summary. I looped in Ben (SDR) to do the intake and Aditya (solutions engineer) to own the technical walkthrough and load-test plan.

Quick ask for the intake call: can you confirm the model family (off-the-shelf LLM or custom fine-tuned checkpoints), average request token length, and whether inference will be synchronous or async? That will help Aditya size the test runner.

Ben — can you propose 2 slots (PST mornings / EST early afternoons) that work for the Stratus team? We should reserve 45 minutes: 20m technical overview, 20m load test/throughput, 5m next steps.

Kimberly Park
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

---
Attachment: (intake-form link) https://drive.google.com/intake/form/stratusdata

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Anna Patel <anna@stratusdata.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Demo request: Dedicated capacity for StratusData

Hi Anna / team — thanks for signing up. Two proposed 45m windows (all in PST):
- Thu 11/05 09:00–09:45 PT / 12:00–12:45 ET
- Fri 11/06 10:30–11:15 PT / 13:30–14:15 ET

If neither works, tell me two windows that are better and I'll re-propose.

A couple clarifying questions to help Aditya prepare:
- Model: are you evaluating an open Llama-style model or a proprietary custom model?
- Peak traffic pattern: is the 450 QPS spike sustained sequentially (burst) or distributed across different routes?

We'll send a calendar invite once we lock a slot; Aditya plans to bring Marcus from Ops to run the load test and answer infra/network questions.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Anna Patel <anna@stratusdata.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo request: Dedicated capacity for StratusData

Thanks Ben — appreciate the quick response. Neither of those slots work for our platform team (we have a quarterly release on Thu). Can you do Mon 11/09 11:00–11:45 PT / 14:00–14:45 ET instead? If not, Tue 11/10 late morning PT is ok.

To answer your questions:
- Model: hybrid — mostly an open LLM baseline with a small custom fine-tuned head for ranking.
- Spikes: distributed across 3 endpoints but we need end-to-end guarantee for the heaviest route.

We definitely want the load test to be recorded and for Redwood to provide a short summary of the test conditions and results (CSV preferred).

Anna

Subject: Confirming Mon 11/09 11:00 PT + runbook

Anna — thanks for the note and for confirming details. Mon 11/09 11:00–11:45 PT / 14:00–14:45 ET works for our team. I booked the slot and attached the demo runbook and a preliminary capacity estimate we used during sizing. Marcus will join to cover VPC/network peering and the load-runner plan.

Agenda (45m):
- 10m: Redwood Dedicated architecture & model compatibility (me)
- 20m: Throughput/latency load test with live runner (Marcus)
- 10m: Network/KMS & next steps (Kimberly)
- 5m: Recording + artifacts + follow-ups

Deliverables after the demo: CSV test results, short PDF summary, and recommended quantization/instance profiles for your workload.

Attachments: dedicated_runbook.pdf, capacity_estimate.xlsx
Calendar: redwood_demo_invite.ics (contains conference link)

If there are platform restrictions for running a load test (IP allow-lists, code-run policies), let us know and Marcus will coordinate.

See you Monday — Aditya
Aditya Rao

Perfect — we got the invite and the attachments. One last ask: can you prioritize showing p95 token latency for an 8k context in the test summary? That's the metric our infra team will use to greenlight any Dedicated purchase.

We'll be on the call with two engineers and our platform security lead. If you could also include a short slide on data isolation and log retention settings that would be helpful.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Anna
